_comment: Players who join the 2026-27 pool REGARDLESS of the MPG>=12 / G>=40 rule. This file COMPOSES with that rule rather than replacing it: scripts/cardgen/generatePool.js keeps everyone the rule already admits and adds everyone named here. Keyed by the player name exactly as Basketball-Reference's per-game table spells it (a name that matches no row is reported by the generator rather than silently ignored). The value is the one-line reason, which is the whole point of the file: a bare list of names would lose why each one is here. WHY THIS EXISTS: the G>=40 half of the rule quietly drops anyone whose season was cut short by injury, star or not — the 18 names below are every player in the 2025-26 table with MPG>=25 (a real rotation or star role when healthy) and G<40, found and decided on 2026-08-28. Ty Jerome is a separate case: a direct individual pick, not an injury exception. See memory/new_season_player_pool.md. NOTE ON THEIR NUMBERS: these players are carded on their 2025-26 sample alone. The shooting layer's empirical-Bayes shrinkage already discounts their low-volume location percentages automatically, but TS% (and so the Shot Line) is deliberately not shrunk, so a short sample carries full weight there. Blending in 2024-25 was the stated preference and is NOT done: the season's EPM/EW source is locked for prior seasons and Basketball-Reference carries neither stat, so a blend is a cross-source normalisation project rather than a pooling job.
Ty Jerome: individual pick, asked for by name 2026-08-29 — 15 G at 22.6 MPG, fails both halves of the rule and is not an injury-star case
